name: Better Dustin5
description: Dustin5 and the Rewards Box made easier: every Dustin5 free with no 5-item limit (or more items for a price you set), no waiting at Dustin5, and in the Rewards Box Triangle sends a present to the Storage Box, L1 sends everything there and R1 takes everything. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Every Dustin5 is free
settings.help: On: every Dustin5 in the Tower is a free one, as a few already are - nothing to pay, and as many items a send as you like. Off: the paid ones stay paid, at the price below, and take the number of items below.

settings.label: Price of a paid send
settings.help: The game's own is 5,000 KC. Capped at 200,000 - the highest price this field is ever set to anywhere in the stock game.

settings.label: Items a paid send
settings.help: The game's own is 5. 70 is a whole Death Bag at its biggest (60 with the Bag Size mod, plus the Express Pass's 10). A free Dustin5 has no limit.

settings.label: No waiting at Dustin5
settings.help: The menu opens straight away instead of up to 5 seconds later, and after a send there is no wait while Dustin5 and your fighter play their animations.

settings.label: Rewards Box: Storage Box and take everything
settings.help: In the Rewards Box: Triangle sends the picked present to the Storage Box, L1 everything that fits there, and R1 takes everything that fits, as taking each one would - each after a Yes/No, and the list's button guide shows all three. Weapons, armour and items go to storage; Kill Coins, decals and the rest go where they always go. No result screen is shown for these. The Storage Box refreshes each time it opens, so what was sent there shows.

patches.description: Every Dustin5 is a free one
patches.sql: UPDATE master_dustshooter SET type = 'FREE' WHERE type = 'CHARGE';
